if(storyPageResizeObserver)storyPageResizeObserver.observe($('storyPageWrap'));
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(!storyStage)return;if(document.hidden)storyClearTimer();else storySchedule(1600);});

// LUNCH RACE: 80 entrants -> three-panel comic, 100 entrants -> ending.
// Fictional 10-minute clock is mapped to the next 20 entering customers.
const LUNCH_START=80,LUNCH_END=100,LUNCH_GOAL=1200;
let lunchTriggered=false,lunchFinalPlayed=false,lunchEndless=false,lunchSceneActive=false;
let lunchTotalEarned=0,lunchStage='',lunchPage=0,lunchSlides=[];
function formatLunchTime(customersRemaining){
 const secs=Math.max(0,Math.round(customersRemaining*30));
 return String(Math.floor(secs/60)).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(secs%60).padStart(2,'0');
}
function refreshLunchHud(){
 const panel=$('lunchRaceHud');if(!panel)return;
 panel.hidden=!lunchTriggered||(!lunchEndless&&buyerEntered<LUNCH_START);
 if(panel.hidden)return;
 if(lunchEndless){$('lunchRaceLabel').textContent='★ БЕСКОНЕЧНАЯ СМЕНА';$('lunchRaceCountdown').textContent='∞';$('lunchRaceRemaining').textContent='РЕКОРД: '+score+' ОЧ.';$('lunchRaceFill').style.width='100%';return;}
 const remaining=Math.max(0,LUNCH_END-buyerEntered);
 $('lunchRaceLabel').textContent='ДО ОБЕДА';$('lunchRaceCountdown').textContent=formatLunchTime(remaining);
 $('lunchRaceRemaining').textContent=remaining+' покупателей · цель '+LUNCH_GOAL+' оч.';
 $('lunchRaceFill').style.width=(100-remaining*5)+'%';
}
function makeLunchSlides(stage){
 if(stage==='intro')return [
 {title:'11:45 — ПЛОХИЕ НОВОСТИ',clock:'11:45',bubble:'ЧТО?! УЖЕ 11:45?!',stamp:'80-Й ПОКУПАТЕЛЬ'},
 {title:'ОПЕРАЦИЯ «ЧАО»',clock:'11:45',bubble:'ЧЕРЕЗ 10 МИНУТ НУЖНО ВЫХОДИТЬ НА ОБЕД В «ЧАО»!',stamp:'ОБЕД ПОД УГРОЗОЙ'},
 {title:'ПОСЛЕДНИЙ РЫВОК',clock:'11:45',bubble:'ИНАЧЕ ОФИСНЫЕ ЗАЙМУТ ВСЕ МЕСТА! ЕЩЁ 20 ПОКУПАТЕЛЕЙ — И НА ОБЕД!',stamp:'ЦЕЛЬ: '+LUNCH_GOAL+' ОЧКОВ'}
 ];
 if(stage==='win')return [
 {title:'11:55 — ПЛАН ВЫПОЛНЕН',clock:'11:55',bubble:'ГОТОВО! ПЛАН ПО ПРОМО ЕСТЬ!',stamp:'+'+lunchTotalEarned+' ОЧКОВ'},
 {title:'В «ЧАО»!',clock:'11:55',bubble:'ПОСМЫ СТОЯТ, МЕРЧИ ПОБЕЖДЕНЫ! БЕЖИМ НА ОБЕД!',stamp:'ОБЕД СПАСЁН'},
 {title:'ПОБЕДА!',clock:'11:55',bubble:'УСПЕЛИ! ВОТ ТЕПЕРЬ МОЖНО И ПОЕСТЬ!',stamp:'PROMO COMPLETE!'}
 ];
 return [
 {title:'11:55 — ПЛАН НЕ ГОТОВ',clock:'11:55',bubble:'КАК ЭТО НЕ ХВАТИЛО ОЧКОВ?!',stamp:'НАБРАНО: '+lunchTotalEarned+' / '+LUNCH_GOAL},
 {title:'ОБЕД ПОД УГРОЗОЙ',clock:'11:55',bubble:'ПОКА МЫ ВОЗИЛИСЬ С ПОСМАМИ, ОФИСНЫЕ УЖЕ ЗАНЯЛИ ВСЕ МЕСТА!',stamp:'В «ЧАО» ОЧЕРЕДЬ'},
 {title:'ПРОМО ПРОВАЛЕНО',clock:'11:55',bubble:'НИ ПОСМОB, НИ ОБЕДА... ЛАДНО, ИГРАЕМ ДАЛЬШЕ!',stamp:'ПОПРОБУЙ ПОБИТЬ РЕКОРД'}
 ];
}
function showLunchPanel(){
 const slide=lunchSlides[lunchPage];if(!slide)return;
 const title=$('lunchComicTitle');title.textContent=slide.title;
 title.className='lunchComicTitle'+(lunchStage==='win'?' good':lunchStage==='lose'?' bad':'');
 $('lunchComicClock').textContent=slide.clock;
 $('lunchComicBubble').textContent=slide.bubble;
 $('lunchComicStamp').textContent=slide.stamp;
 $('lunchComicFooter').textContent=String(lunchPage+1).padStart(2,'0')+' / '+String(lunchSlides.length).padStart(2,'0');
 $('lunchComicNext').textContent=lunchPage===lunchSlides.length-1?(lunchStage==='intro'?'▶ НАЧАТЬ ГОНКУ К ОБЕДУ':'★ БЕСКОНЕЧНАЯ СМЕНА'):'ДАЛЬШЕ ▶';
 $('lunchComicHero').src=HERO_SPRITE_DATA['right_idle'];
}
function beginLunchComic(stage){
 lunchStage=stage;
 playStoryScene(stage==='intro'?'lunch':stage);
}
function nextLunchComic(){storyAdvance();}
$('lunchComicNext').addEventListener('click',nextLunchComic);
function checkLunchMilestones(){
 if(mode!=='play')return;
 if(!lunchTriggered&&buyerEntered>=LUNCH_START){lunchTriggered=true;beginLunchComic('intro');}
 else if(lunchTriggered&&!lunchFinalPlayed&&buyerEntered>=LUNCH_END){
  lunchFinalPlayed=true;beginLunchComic(lunchTotalEarned>=LUNCH_GOAL?'win':'lose');
 }
 refreshLunchHud();
}
function spawnBuyer(){const from=entryPoint(),codes=Object.keys(CATS),code=pick(codes),destination=chooseGoal(from,code);
// First trolley arrives with shopper #30. Thereafter about one in six.
const trolley=(buyerEntered+1===30)||(buyerEntered+1>30&&Math.random()<.17);
const stops=[];
if(trolley&&destination){stops.push({code,goal:destination});
 const otherCodes=codes.filter(x=>x!==code);const total=2+(Math.random()<.5?1:0);
 while(stops.length<total&&otherCodes.length){const ix=Math.floor(Math.random()*otherCodes.length),nextCode=otherCodes.splice(ix,1)[0];
  const prev=stops.at(-1).goal,nextGoal=chooseGoal(center(prev),nextCode);
  if(nextGoal)stops.push({code:nextCode,goal:nextGoal});
 }
}
if(!destination){setMsg('Для категории '+code+' нет доступного пути.');return null}
// 80% of shoppers enter deep into the shop before turning left along
// the central promo alley. These are preferences, not forced dead ends.
const mainAisle=Math.random()<.8;
const legs=mainAisle?[{x:21,y:11},{x:17,y:10},destination]:[destination];
const c={id:uid++,x:from.x,y:from.y,r:.20,cart:trolley,shopStops:stops,shopStopIndex:0,code,stage:'category',destination,legs,legIndex:0,mainAisle,goal:legs[0],route:[],routeIndex:0,wait:0,speechWait:0,hasCandy:false,candyCount:0,purchasedProduct:null,purchasedKind:null,buying:null,oldBlock:null,text:'',textUntil:0,rerouteAt:0,routeBlockedAt:0,escapeMode:0,variant:customerVariantForCode(code),dir:'down',anim:'idle',animClock:Math.random()*.5};
initCustomerSpriteState(c);
       rerouteBuyer(c);customers.push(c);buyerEntered++;checkLunchMilestones();speaker(c,trolley?'Сегодня большая закупка!':'Иду в отдел: '+CATS[code].where,2.0);setMsg(trolley?'ПОКУПАТЕЛЬ С ТЕЛЕЖКОЙ: '+stops.length+' отдела, награда ×2!':CATS[code].name+' вошёл в магазин → '+CATS[code].where);if(mode==='play'&&running&&buyerEntered>=nextThiefAt&&!thief){if(spawnThief())nextThiefAt=buyerEntered+10+Math.floor(Math.random()*11);}return c}
// A shop-awarded permanent stand is a REAL wall for every character.
// Customers only ignore POSMs when planning their first optimistic route;
// on contact they search for a physically traversable alternative.
// A candy sale is possible only when removing a NORMAL stand/theatre opens
// a route that currently does not exist. Two indestructible stands alone
// are never a source of unlimited automatic purchases.
function buyerTrapSolution(c,blocker=null){
if(findRoute(c,[c.goal],false,false))return null;
const releasable=map.posm.filter(p=>(p.kind==='stand'||p.kind==='theater')&&
findRoute(c,[c.goal],false,false,p.id));
if(!releasable.length)return null;
releasable.sort((a,b)=>{
const da=dist(c,center(a))-(a.id===blocker?.id?.25:0);
const db=dist(c,center(b))-(b.id===blocker?.id?.25:0);
return da-db;
});
const release=releasable[0];
// Only sell FROM the permanent stand when it truly participates in the
// same blockade. Merely passing a protected stand does not trigger sales.
const protectedSource=map.posm.filter(p=>p.kind==='permanent'&&
dist(c,center(p))<=3.1&&findRoute(c,[c.goal],false,false,p.id))
.sort((a,b)=>dist(c,center(a))-dist(c,center(b)))[0];
return {source:protectedSource||release,release};
}
// Prefer a genuine route, and treat intermediate sightseeing points as optional.
function buyerAlternativeGoal(c){
  let choices=[];
  if(c.stage==='category')choices=adjacentTargets(c.code);
  else if(c.stage==='checkout')choices=cells('З').filter(t=>t.y===20&&tile(t.x,21)==='Х');
  else if(c.stage==='exit')choices=cells('Х');
  if(!choices.length)return false;
  let found=choices.map(goal=>({goal,route:findRoute(c,[goal],c.escapeMode===2,c.escapeMode===1)}))
     .filter(v=>v.route).sort((a,b)=>a.route.length-b.route.length);
  if(!found.length)return false;
  c.goal=found[0].goal;
  if(c.stage==='category'){c.destination=c.goal;c.legIndex=c.legs.length-1;}
  return plan(c,c.goal,false);
}
function upgradeBuyerPass(c){
  // Only shoppers who already bought sweets may squeeze past otherwise
  // indestructible POSM. The displays remain intact for everyone else.
  if(!c.hasCandy)return false;
  for(const mode of [Math.max(1,c.escapeMode||0),2]){
    c.escapeMode=mode;
    if(plan(c,c.goal,false)||buyerAlternativeGoal(c))return true;
  }
  return false;
}
function rerouteBuyer(c,blocker=null){
  // Detect narrow passages that appear navigable on the tile grid but repeatedly
  // stop the actual collision circle. Recover instead of retrying forever.
  if(!c.routeBlockedAt)c.routeBlockedAt=gameTime||.001;
  if(gameTime-c.routeBlockedAt>2.2){
    if(c.hasCandy){
      if(upgradeBuyerPass(c)){c.routeBlockedAt=0;return true;}
    }else if(!c.buying){
      const candidate=(blocker&&map.posm.find(p=>p.id===blocker.id))||
        map.posm.filter(p=>p.kind!=='stripe').sort((a,b)=>dist(c,center(a))-dist(c,center(b)))[0];
      if(candidate){purchase(c,candidate,null);return false;}
    }
  }
  if(plan(c,c.goal,false)||buyerAlternativeGoal(c))return true;
  if(!c.hasCandy&&!c.buying){
    const trap=buyerTrapSolution(c,blocker);
    if(trap){purchase(c,trap.source,trap.release.id);return false;}
    // A blockade made entirely of permanent stands cannot disappear. After
    // inspecting the aisle, take sweets and use a shopper-only narrow gap.
    const candidates=map.posm.filter(p=>p.kind==='permanent'||p.kind==='stand'||p.kind==='theater');
    const chosen=(blocker&&candidates.find(p=>p.id===blocker.id))||
      candidates.sort((a,b)=>dist(c,center(a))-dist(c,center(b)))[0];
    if(chosen&&gameTime-c.routeBlockedAt>=1.2){
      purchase(c,chosen,null);
      return false;
    }
  }else if(c.hasCandy&&gameTime-c.routeBlockedAt>=1.2){
    if(upgradeBuyerPass(c)){
      speaker(c,'Всё, конфеты взял. Протиснусь к кассам!',2.4);
      c.routeBlockedAt=0;return true;
    }
  }
  if(gameTime>(c.trappedSpeechAt||0)){
    speaker(c,'Проход закрыт. Ищу обход...',2);
    c.trappedSpeechAt=gameTime+5;
  }
  c.route=[];c.routeIndex=0;c.rerouteAt=gameTime+0.7;
  return false;
}
// Buyers select candy first: the blocking POSM remains on the floor
// for the full decision animation; only a genuine trap can start buying.
// Every completed sale consumes one ordinary display. Permanent stands never disappear.
// When a two-blocker trap is solved, consume the blocking second display;
// otherwise consume the normal display that supplied the sweets.
function purchase(c,chosen,releaseId){
  if(c.hasCandy||c.buying||!chosen||chosen.kind==='stripe')return;
  const explicitRelease=releaseId==null?null:map.posm.find(p=>p.id===releaseId);
  if(releaseId!=null&&(!explicitRelease||!['stand','theater'].includes(explicitRelease.kind)))return;
  const product=productForPOSM(chosen.kind);
  const doubleCandy=chosen.kind==='theater';
  const duration=doubleCandy?balance.theaterSaleWait:balance.saleWait;
  const consumed=explicitRelease || (chosen.kind==='stand'||chosen.kind==='theater'?chosen:null);
  c.buying={posmId:chosen.id,releasePosmId:consumed?.id??null,kind:chosen.kind,product,doubleCandy,elapsed:0,duration};
  speaker(c,doubleCandy?'Ого, тут целых две упаковки '+product+'!':'Хм, '+product+'. Заманчивая выкладка!',Math.min(2.4,duration+.35));
  setMsg(CATS[c.code].name+' выбирает '+(doubleCandy?'две упаковки ':'упаковку ')+product+'...');
}
function unblockAfterSale(c,releaseId){
  if(c.stage==='category'&&c.legIndex<c.legs.length-1){c.legIndex=c.legs.length-1;c.goal=c.destination;}
  const removed=map.posm.find(p=>p.id===releaseId);
  // Never remove the protected, permanent store stand.
  if(removed&&(removed.kind==='stand'||removed.kind==='theater')){
    map.posm.splice(map.posm.indexOf(removed),1);
  }
  // Always try a real accessible route before letting the shopper squeeze past POSM.
  c.escapeMode=0;
  if(!plan(c,c.goal,false)&&!buyerAlternativeGoal(c)&&!upgradeBuyerPass(c)){
    c.route=[];c.routeIndex=0;c.rerouteAt=gameTime+0.85;
  }
}
function finishPurchase(c){
  const transaction=c.buying;if(!transaction)return;
  const chosen=map.posm.find(p=>p.id===transaction.posmId);
  c.buying=null;
  if(!chosen){
    speaker(c,'Ой, выкладку уже убрали!',1.8);
    if(!plan(c,c.goal,false)&&!buyerAlternativeGoal(c)){
      if(c.stage==='category'&&c.legIndex<c.legs.length-1){c.legIndex=c.legs.length-1;c.goal=c.destination;}
      plan(c,c.goal,true);
    }
    return;
  }
  const baseAmount=transaction.doubleCandy?balance.theaterReward:balance.reward;
  const amount=Math.max(1,Math.round(baseAmount*(1-payoutPenalty)*(c.cart?2:1)));
  const product=transaction.product||productForPOSM(transaction.kind);
  c.hasCandy=true;c.candyCount=transaction.doubleCandy?2:1;
  c.purchasedProduct=product;c.purchasedKind=transaction.kind;
  sales++;score+=amount;money+=amount;lunchTotalEarned+=amount;
  speaker(c,transaction.doubleCandy?'Ладно, беру две упаковки '+product+'!':productLine(c,product),3.8);
  if(transaction.releasePosmId!=null){
    unblockAfterSale(c,transaction.releasePosmId);
  }else{
    // Sale from a permanent stand: award candy without destroying that display.
    if(c.stage==='category'&&c.legIndex<c.legs.length-1){c.legIndex=c.legs.length-1;c.goal=c.destination;}
    if(!plan(c,c.goal,false)&&!buyerAlternativeGoal(c))upgradeBuyerPass(c);
  }
  setMsg('ПОКУПКА! '+c.candyCount+' '+(c.candyCount===2?'упаковки':'упаковка')+' '+product+' · +'+amount+' ₽');
  updateUI();
}
function finishStage(c){
if(c.stage==='category'){
if(c.legIndex<c.legs.length-1){c.legIndex++;c.goal=c.legs[c.legIndex];plan(c,c.goal,true);return}
 // A trolley shopper visits two or three genuinely different departments.
 if(c.cart&&c.shopStopIndex<c.shopStops.length-1){
   c.shopStopIndex++;const stop=c.shopStops[c.shopStopIndex];c.code=stop.code;
   c.destination=stop.goal;c.legs=[stop.goal];c.legIndex=0;c.goal=stop.goal;
   if(!plan(c,c.goal,false))rerouteBuyer(c);
   speaker(c,'Теперь в отдел: '+CATS[stop.code].where,2.2);return;
 }
 c.stage='shopping';c.wait=rand(1.8,3.5);speaker(c,'Нашёл! Теперь выбрать...',2.2);
}else if(c.stage==='checkout'){
c.stage='paying';c.wait=balance.checkoutWait+rand(-.45,.65);
speaker(c,c.hasCandy?'Оплачу и '+(c.purchasedProduct||'сладости')+' тоже.':'Сейчас оплачу покупки...',2.2);
}else if(c.stage==='exit'){
c.stage='done';if(!c.hasCandy){lost++;setMsg(CATS[c.code].name+' ушёл без наших конфет.');updateUI()}
}
}
function updateBuyer(c,dt){if(c.stage==='done')return;
if(c.buying){
setCustomerPose(c,'take',0,0,dt);
c.buying.elapsed+=dt;
if(c.buying.elapsed>=c.buying.duration)finishPurchase(c);
return;
}
if(c.wait>0){setCustomerPose(c,c.stage==='shopping'?'take':'idle',0,0,dt);c.wait-=dt;if(c.wait<=0){
if(c.stage==='shopping'){c.stage='checkout';c.goal=closestCash(c);if(!plan(c,c.goal,false))rerouteBuyer(c);speaker(c,'Теперь к кассе...',1.6)}
else if(c.stage==='paying'){c.stage='exit';c.goal={x:Math.floor(c.x),y:21};if(tile(c.goal.x,c.goal.y)!=='Х')c.goal=cells('Х').find(a=>a.y===21&&tile(a.x,20)==='З')||c.goal;if(!plan(c,c.goal,false))rerouteBuyer(c);speaker(c,'До свидания!',1.5)}
}return}

if(c.routeIndex>=c.route.length){if(dist(c,center(c.goal))<.25){setCustomerPose(c,'idle',0,0,dt);finishStage(c);return}if(gameTime>=c.rerouteAt)rerouteBuyer(c)}
const next=c.route[c.routeIndex];
if(!next){
setCustomerPose(c,'idle',0,0,dt);
if(gameTime>c.rerouteAt)rerouteBuyer(c);
return;
}
// The optimistic route may ignore displays; actual walking NEVER does.
if(occupied(next.x,next.y,c.escapeMode===2,c.escapeMode===1)){
    if(gameTime<c.rerouteAt)return;
const obstacle=findPOSM(next.x,next.y);
if(obstacle)c.oldBlock=obstacle.id;
if(gameTime>c.speechWait){speaker(c,pick(CATS[c.code].lines),2.3);c.speechWait=gameTime+3.5;}
rerouteBuyer(c,obstacle);
return;
}
const target=center(next),d=dist(c,target),max=balance.playerSpeed*CATS[c.code].factor*balance.buyerFactor*dt;
if(d<.035){
if(clearAt(target.x,target.y,c.r,c)){
c.x=target.x;c.y=target.y;c.routeIndex++;setCustomerPose(c,'idle',0,0,dt);
}else rerouteBuyer(c,findPOSM(next.x,next.y));
return;
}
const step=Math.min(max,d),dx=(target.x-c.x)/d*step,dy=(target.y-c.y)/d*step;
const xx=c.x,yy=c.y;
moveActor(c,dx,dy,c.r);
const mx=c.x-xx,my=c.y-yy;
if(Math.hypot(mx,my)<step*.2){
if(gameTime>=c.rerouteAt)rerouteBuyer(c,findPOSM(next.x,next.y));
else setCustomerPose(c,'idle',0,0,dt);
}else{c.routeBlockedAt=0;setCustomerPose(c,'walk',mx,my,dt);}
}

// STORE SECURITY EVENT — schematic thief. No fixed or visible route.
// Every decision uses the current aisle connectivity. Only normal POSM can trap him.
// Pause game time during the introduction, but keep cinematic camera moving.
// The camera starts at the hero, smoothly approaches the entrance, then after
// acknowledgement returns to the hero before gameplay resumes.
function showThiefNotice(title,message,focus=false){
thiefModal={title,message,focus};
$('thiefAlertTitle').textContent=title;
$('thiefAlertBody').textContent=message;
keys.clear();joy.dx=joy.dy=0;
if(focus&&thief){
thiefCinematic={phase:'approach',elapsed:0,duration:1.65,
from:{...currentCamera},to:thiefFocusCamera()};
$('thiefAlert').hidden=true;
}else{
thiefCinematic=null;
$('thiefAlert').hidden=false;
}
}
function closeThiefNotice(){
$('thiefAlert').hidden=true;
if(thiefModal?.focus&&thiefCinematic){
thiefCinematic={phase:'return',elapsed:0,duration:1.25,
from:camera(),to:playerCamera()};
}else{
thiefModal=null;
thiefCinematic=null;
}
}
function updateThiefCinematic(dt){
if(paused||!$('arcadePause').hidden)return;
const c=thiefCinematic;
if(!c||c.phase==='hold')return;
c.elapsed=Math.min(c.duration,c.elapsed+dt);
if(c.elapsed<c.duration)return;
if(c.phase==='approach'){
c.phase='hold';
$('thiefAlert').hidden=false;
}else if(c.phase==='return'){
thiefCinematic=null;
thiefModal=null;
}
}
function chooseThiefShelf(from){
const goods=adjacentTargets('С').map(goal=>({goal,route:thiefFindRoute(from,[goal])})).filter(a=>a.route);
if(!goods.length)return null;
goods.sort((a,b)=>b.route.length-a.route.length);
return pick(goods.slice(0,Math.min(9,goods.length))).goal;
}
function spawnThief(){
if(thief||mode!=='play')return false;
const from=entryPoint();
const destination=chooseThiefShelf(from);
if(!destination)return false;
thief={id:uid++,kind:'thief',x:from.x,y:from.y,r:.20,stage:'toShelf',goal:destination,
destination,route:[],routeIndex:0,rerouteAt:0,blockedSince:0,wait:0,stolen:false,
speed:1.8,dir:'up',anim:'idle',animClock:0,grabElapsed:0,text:'',textUntil:0};
thief.route=thiefFindRoute(thief,[thief.goal])||[];
thief.routeIndex=thief.route.length>1?1:0;
if(!thiefIntroduced){
thiefIntroduced=true;
showThiefNotice('ВНИМАНИЕ! МУТНАЯ ЛИЧНОСТЬ',
'Администрация: в зале появился подозрительный посетитель. Он быстро схватит конфеты и уйдёт через вход, минуя кассы.\nПерекрой ему выход минимум ДВУМЯ POSM. Если пути не останется — получишь защищённую стойку Toffifee. Если сбежит — выплата магазина снизится на 2%.',true);
}else setMsg('ОХРАНА: мутная личность снова в магазине! Заблокируй её двумя POSM.');
return true;
}
function thiefExitTiles(){
// The robber can use ANY legal entry/exit tile, not a single frozen goal.
const all=cells('В');
const bottom=Math.max(-1,...all.map(c=>c.y));
return all.filter(c=>c.y===bottom);
}
// The thief and the actual game collision system must agree on which
// corridors can be walked through. A route between tile centres must also
// allow the thief's collision circle to pass through it.
function thiefCanUseCell(x,y,r=.20){
return !occupied(x,y,false)&&clearAt(x+.5,y+.5,r);
}
function thiefFindRoute(o,goals){
if(!goals?.length)return null;
const sx=Math.floor(o.x),sy=Math.floor(o.y),root={x:sx,y:sy};
if(!inside(sx,sy))return null;
const exits=new Set(goals.map(p=>k(p.x,p.y)));
const queue=[root],back=new Map(),seen=new Set([k(sx,sy)]);
let found=null;
for(let q=0;q<queue.length;q++){
const here=queue[q],hereKey=k(here.x,here.y);
if(exits.has(hereKey)){found=here;break;}
for(const next of neighbors(here)){
const nk=k(next.x,next.y);
if(seen.has(nk)||!thiefCanUseCell(next.x,next.y,o.r||.20))continue;
seen.add(nk);back.set(nk,here);queue.push(next);
}
}
if(!found)return null;
const result=[found];
while(back.has(k(result.at(-1).x,result.at(-1).y))){
result.push(back.get(k(result.at(-1).x,result.at(-1).y)));
}
return result.reverse();
}
function thiefEscapeRoute(o){return thiefFindRoute(o,thiefExitTiles());}
function thiefExitGoal(o){return thiefEscapeRoute(o)?.at(-1)||null;}
// Count the DISTINCT POSM objects touching the boundary of the part of the
// shop reachable by the thief. There is no arbitrary 3-cell catch radius:
// when the player encloses a larger area, the trap must still be registered.
function thiefTrapAssessment(o){
const start={x:Math.floor(o.x),y:Math.floor(o.y)};
const queue=[start],seen=new Set([k(start.x,start.y)]);
const exits=new Set(thiefExitTiles().map(p=>k(p.x,p.y)));
const blockers=new Set();
let exitReachable=false;
for(let q=0;q<queue.length;q++){
const c=queue[q];
if(exits.has(k(c.x,c.y)))return {exitReachable:true,blockers};
for(const n of neighbors(c)){
const nk=k(n.x,n.y);
if(seen.has(nk))continue;
if(!PALETTE[tile(n.x,n.y)].walk)continue;
const blocking=map.posm.find(p=>p.kind!=='stripe'&&
n.x>=p.x&&n.x<p.x+KINDS[p.kind].size&&
n.y>=p.y&&n.y<p.y+KINDS[p.kind].size);
if(blocking){blockers.add(blocking.id);continue;}
if(!thiefCanUseCell(n.x,n.y,o.r||.20))continue;
seen.add(nk);queue.push(n);
}
}
return {exitReachable,blockers};
}
function thiefIsActuallyTrapped(o,dt){
// A genuine trap needs at least TWO separate blocking POSMs around the
// reachable area, and no physical path to any store entrance/exit.
// Check intermittently to avoid scanning the entire store every frame.
o.trapCheckDelay=(o.trapCheckDelay||0)-dt;
if(o.trapCheckDelay>0)return false;
const interval=.12;
o.trapCheckDelay=interval;
const assessment=thiefTrapAssessment(o);
// Never award a capture if the static supermarket layout is itself broken.
const caught=!assessment.exitReachable&&assessment.blockers.size>=2&&
!!findRoute(o,thiefExitTiles(),true);
if(!caught){o.trapSince=0;return false;}
o.trapSince=(o.trapSince||0)+interval;
if(o.trapSince<.48)return false;
captureThief();
return true;
}
function thiefAlternativeShelf(o){
const candidates=adjacentTargets('С').map(goal=>({goal,route:thiefFindRoute(o,[goal])}))
.filter(a=>a.route);
candidates.sort((a,b)=>a.route.length-b.route.length);
return candidates[0]?.goal||null;
}
function thiefLeavesWithoutLoot(){
if(!thief)return;
thief=null;
setMsg('МУТНАЯ ЛИЧНОСТЬ УШЛА С ПУСТЫМИ РУКАМИ — потерь магазина нет.');
showThiefNotice('КРАЖУ ПРЕДОТВРАТИЛИ',
'Вор не смог добраться до конфет и покинул магазин без товара. Премия и стойки не изменились.');
}

// actors freeze while the arrest cutscene plays.
